subject: Re: CISC kickoff — cheaper self-consistency for reasoning endpoints
body:
Reproduction + A/B status.

Good news: on our three production reasoning models, CISC's weighted majority vote hits self-consistency parity at 38–44% fewer sampled paths, right in line with the paper's 40%+ claim. On the internal math suite it's actually accuracy-positive at equal budget.

The caveat Umar predicted: confidence method choice matters a lot, and — exactly as the paper found — the most calibrated method is the least effective for CISC. Our best-calibrated prod confidence head underperforms; the cheap verbalized-confidence prompt wins. Counterintuitive but consistent with the within-question evaluation story: what matters is ranking answers within a question, not global calibration.

Risk: verbalized confidence adds ~35 tokens/path. Net savings still large (~36%) but the headline number shrinks. Nikhil's A/B harness starts on logged traffic Monday.

Katya
